build_swiss_roll_data: build a swiss roll dataset with 1500 samples using sklearn datasets.make_swiss_roll
build_swiss_hole_data: build a swiss roll dataset with a hole using sklearn datasets.make_swiss_roll with hole=True
run_locally_linear_embedding: run locally linear embedding on swiss roll data with 12 neighbors and 2 components
run_tsne_embedding: run t-SNE dimensionality reduction on swiss roll data with perplexity 40
run_tsne_swiss_hole: run t-SNE dimensionality reduction on swiss hole data with random initialization
